content: I've been wanting to learn Lean on my android device. So I used OpenAI's codex to make a Lean4 editor for android. I am not an android developer and the code was entirely written by GPT5. It has some bugs and does not work with mathlib but I thought to share it here: https://github.com/L-iet/Lean4Android
Running lean on android was already possible through termux, though a dedicated app might come with benefits.
Yes, I used to do that, but I wanted something closer to an IDE without needing termux.
Maybe you could add screenshots to show what advantages or features this has compared to using live.lean in a browser or termux?
